name: hey-my-buddy
description: Host-directed DSH and ZCode work with durable model routing, explicit Git workspaces, verified artifacts, shared evaluations and a private React/Vite console.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate bounded work through local Buddy harnesses.
interface.longDescription: Delegate scoped work through one uv-managed Buddy CLI. Choose a complete model configuration or route under hard constraints using the bounded shared evaluation table. Explicit Git snapshots and Host capabilities govern assistance, continuation and final acceptance. Independent workers own DSH and ZCode processes; Python and C-Two retain durable state. A private React/Vite console shows tasks, evaluations and actionable Host decisions. Background follow-up uses an explicit App heartbeat.
defaultPrompt: Delegate a bounded task with Buddy and verify its artifacts.
